title.narrative: EU4DigitalSME: EU support for digitalization of Small and Medium size Enterprises in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: The overall EU4 SMEs Programme will support the creation of business environment for technological transformation of SMEs in competitive sectors to mitigate the effects of COVID-19 on BiHs economy. It will be implemented by the EBRD and GIZ. Each Organisation will be responsible for the specific Actions of the Programme. The GIZ will support the development of a more conducive operational framework for innovative business models and strengthen BiH capacities for collaborating on advanced technology solutions in the joint regional and EU projects, following the best EU practice, namely Digital Innovation Hubs (DIH).

title.narrative: Ease of Doing Business ranking

description.narrative: World Bank ranking. Higher rankings (a low numerical value) indicate better, usually simpler, regulations for businesses and stronger protections of property rights.Limitations of the indicator: Besides its exclusive focus on the cost of regulation and not on the quality (with the consequent risk of promoting deregulation) and its risks for distorting policy priorities ( promotes the focus of governments on climbing in the ranking rather than in reforming their business environment), the methodological weaknesses are even more pronounced in the context of SubSaharan Africa, in which the number of reliable data contributors is very limited.
